Daily wellness for glowing skin

A supplement works best next to good habits. Use this page as a simple checklist for healthier-looking skin, with or without Vita Reboot.

Morning

  • Drink a glass of water before coffee
  • Take your gummy with breakfast
  • Cleanse gently and moisturize
  • Apply sunscreen, every day

Daytime

  • Keep a water bottle within reach
  • Eat colorful fruit and vegetables
  • Take short movement breaks
  • Reapply sunscreen outdoors

Evening

  • Remove makeup and sunscreen fully
  • Wind down screens 30 minutes early
  • Aim for 7 to 9 hours of sleep
  • Change pillowcases weekly

Habits that show on your skin

Hydration

Water, fruit and soup all count. Skin that is well hydrated tends to look smoother and more plump.

Sleep

Skin repairs itself overnight. Regular sleep is one of the simplest free beauty habits there is.

Sun care

Daily sunscreen is the most trusted way to protect skin tone and texture over the years.

Stress and movement

Walks, stretching, yoga or a workout can lift mood and keep your whole routine on track.

A simple 7-day skin routine

Monday to Wednesday

Build the base. Set a gummy time, drink water through the day, and finish with a gentle cleanse and moisturizer.

Thursday to Friday

Check in. Notice how your skin feels, and make sure sleep, sunscreen and meals have not slipped.

Weekend

Reset. Take a walk, wash pillowcases, prep fruit and vegetables, and plan the week ahead.

Everyday foods that fit a skin-friendly plate

Colorful produce

Berries, citrus, carrots, peppers, tomatoes and leafy greens add variety, fiber and fluid to your day.

Healthy fats and protein

Fish, eggs, beans, nuts and olive oil are staples of a balanced diet that supports overall wellness.

Myths and facts

Myth: one product fixes everything

Fact: skin reflects sleep, food, sun, stress and genetics together. A balanced routine beats any single product.

Myth: you only need sunscreen on sunny days

Fact: UV light reaches skin through clouds and windows, so daily sunscreen is a good habit.

Myth: more is always better

Fact: taking more than the label recommends does not improve results and may be unsafe.

Frequently asked questions

What are Vita Reboot Gummies?

They are a dietary supplement in gummy form, made for skin health and everyday wellness.*

How many gummies are in a bottle?

Each bottle contains 30 gummies.

How soon will I notice a difference?

Everyone is different. Supplements are generally used consistently over several weeks, and results vary from person to person.

Can I take them with other supplements or medication?

Talk to your doctor or pharmacist first, especially if you take prescription medication, have a medical condition, or are pregnant or nursing.

Are they suitable for children?

No. Vita Reboot is made for adults and should be kept out of reach of children.

What if I'm not happy with my order?

Your purchase is backed by a 60-day money-back guarantee. Full details are on the purchase page.

When should I take my gummy?

Use the timing on the label. Many people pick a fixed moment, such as breakfast, so they do not forget.

What if I miss a day?

Simply continue the next day as directed. Do not double up to make up for a missed serving.

Do I still need skincare products?

Yes. Cleansing, moisturizing and sunscreen remain important. Vita Reboot is meant to complement them.

How should I store the bottle?

Keep it closed in a cool, dry place, away from heat and direct sunlight.
